text:
Chase is generally better for cashback: it offers 2% on eligible spending, up to £20 a month, if you meet its monthly conditions—15 card or Direct Debit payments and £1,000 held in Chase savings. Monzo’s free account doesn’t offer equivalent guaranteed cashback.
bankinggeek

For savings, Chase looks better for new customers during its 12-month boosted rate, but after that its standard rate is reported to fall below Monzo’s free-plan rate. Check the latest rates and eligibility before switching, since they can change.
